scope.input: The entire current Core13 candidate preserving every old Array/View parameter/alias/call/f64-return shape plus accepted private ReadSpan reference/forwarded returns from original Array/View parameter owners. No Source profile or function projection.
scope.result: An opaque versioned static packet; no execution entry, interpreter, VM/AOT/Host/storage/GC ABI, kernel authority or Source reconstruction.
scope.unsupported: Reject every older private marker/schema/profile and packet version1/2, Array results, local-fresh View escape, cyclic outgoing View domain, new syntax/external/Host/global/control flow, unknown attributes and wrong fixed publication/borrow/proofs. No fallback/conversion/legacy decoder/version relabeling/metadata dropping. Core13/currentpacket3 producer/independent opaque reader are adopted atomically.

canonicalInput.proofs: Run full current Core13 verifier, including independent actual nominal return origin and fixed wider upper checks. Recompute exact Array/View live-before roots and complete parameter/create/call origin family rows, reject differing supplied assertions before normalization, then encode every row/list including zero. Publication presence/table remains semantic and fully retained.
canonicalInput.otherAttributes: Same18 original exact attributes and fields plus mandatory publication attr (UnitAttr only on the existing permitted absence route); no unknown attrs, arbitrary passthrough or metadata laundering.
canonicalInput.identity: Validate original private function/signature/binding/site identities before encoding, without changing the original module identity. The canonical decoded model reconstructs all validated metadata/SSA and normalized proof tables. Original identity preimages unavailable in Core remain explicitly opaque provenance.

validation.whole: Whole complete Core13 verification before measure/encode; independent cold reader validates framing, all original metadata/source/ranges/identities, actual nominal return and origin, fixed full publication/table/hash/Derived+Effective coverage, family creation/inheritance/call completion/lifetimes/roots/SCC before publishing one immutable owning opaque model. No transmitted proof/lower/upper flag is authority.
validation.identities: Function/signature/binding/allocation-site preimages are exactly the existing Core13 RFC8785 finite grammar, UTF16 ranges and valid UTF8 with no NFC. Current core descriptor identity formulas are authoritative. SourceHash/inputIdentity/requestId bind retained provenance; packet alone cannot recover unavailable Source text, packet/HIR hashes or Source export-AST membership.
validation.completeness: Ordered function_ids must equal all encoded function records, each exactly once, including private/unreachable/recursive functions. Exports are the exact encoded original sorted unique subset and resolve to exact whole-table name/id. A self-consistently removed unreachable private function cannot be detected against unavailable Source by a packet-only reader; producer whole-Core validation and independent whole binary gold establish preservation relative to the actual input.
validation.source: Preserve all18 old actual Core module attrs through the same original Module fields, plus the19th publication attr. The Module record has all19 old fields including function body and one new appended publication field. No old original attr or represented function/metadata is projected away.
validation.statementSSA: all actual operations consumed exactly once by complete statement grammar; each literal constant goes to its reached owning create/index/RHS/newLength; create operands exact ordered element defs; alias exact earlier Array def; scalar references exact entry args; store receiver+index selected before RHS then store; resize receiver+newLength then resize; final return exact read result. No extra/detached ops, duplicate statements, hidden blocks, dropped original aliases or omitted represented locals. Array references bind exact Array entry/local SSA; final call-return consumes exact call result. No dropped functions, locals or aliases. Local view owner/start/length evaluation is ordered once before checked-create; view read/length is its exact reached nominal SSA definition. Actual Core recomputes all view last uses and owner edges. ReadSpan entry arguments bind their original nominal parameter IDs; view_alias preserves every original alias SSA with the same family/owner. A final literal/reference has exact tsfg_array.value ScalarUse metadata on func.return; its definition/reference and full original value/return ranges are revalidated. No detached constant or substituted return value. Every discarded View read has exactly one original statement_range attribute with statement.start=read.start and read.end<=statement.end within the original function, preserving ASI equality. It must be the next ordered standalone statement; a value/RHS read must omit this attribute. Do not use a new range to launder an otherwise detached operation. A View call initializer is one actual func.call result bound directly to its original Local metadata; do not add a synthetic view_alias or lose the local. Discarded View calls retain their result SSA and proof row with no fabricated binding. A final View call is consumed immediately by the one final func.return. A View reference return resolves the exact nominal entry/local/alias/call-local SSA and original binding. Returning a View is a real family use. No inline checked-create return or scalar/Array substitution. Original checked View create retains optional inferred Local annotation; present View annotation is strict-inside, empty is not replaced with invented Source ranges.
validation.density: Static finite length knowledge only: each fresh literal count exact, aliases share owner; all Array parameter owners stay permanently unknown and may alias every other parameter owner. Literal store permits known overwrite/exact append only; known literal resize cannot grow. Unknown index/call kills affected knowledge. All Array actual roots and aliases become unknown after any direct call, even a read-only-looking callee. Checked ops remain present regardless of any proof; no future access evaluated.
validation.roots: At every direct call compute exact live-before Array SSA and View SSA, removing the actual call result before adding all actual operands. Retain every true live alias/returned descriptor independently; include the canonical underlying Array owner for every live locally-owned View, including call-produced families. Formal View owners remain indirectly retained by the actual View descriptor, with no fabricated Array register. Discarded results are not pre-call roots; tail results become actual uses only at the immediate return and are never rooted before definition. Sorted unique exact {block,instruction,array_registers,view_registers}; complete recomputation/equality, no physical ABI/GC claim.
validation.views: Build canonical Array owners through original parameters/creates/aliases. A formal View has owner {kind:parameter,index:original full slot} and origin {kind:parameter,index}. A checked local View has owner {kind:array,register:canonical Array root} and origin {kind:create,instruction}. A View-result call whose independently verified callee returnOrigin selects an Array formal maps the actual canonical Array owner and starts a NEW family with origin {kind:call,instruction:actual call}; it begins only after that call completes. If it selects a View formal, inherit the exact actual View family/owner/origin, including every returned alias; do not create a new family or merge different origins merely because owners match. Every View SSA including unused/discarded/tail call results has a distinct normalized row. View read/length/alias/call-actual/return operands extend the shared family last use, even when Published.read=false or the callee body does not read. Core last_use is null only for a formal family with no actual View operand use or a newly created checked-create/Array-origin-call family with no such use. Every view_alias uses its View operand, so its inherited row has nonnull final family last_use >= the alias instruction. Every View-origin call necessarily uses its selected actual View operand through completion, so every inherited result row has nonnull final family last_use >= its defining call, including discarded results; a tail return extends it to func.return. All rows of one family share the exact final last_use. Source plan create-complete events denote birth; they do not invent a Core View-operand use. Direct mutation conflicts only after origin creation and strictly before last use; call structural effects conflict through inclusive call last use. Fresh known overwrite/equal resize exemptions remain unchanged. Complete rows in View SSA register order: exact {view_register:i64,owner:DictionaryAttr,origin:DictionaryAttr,last_use:DenseI64ArrayAttr}. owner={kind="array",register:i64} or {kind="parameter",index:i64}; origin={kind="parameter",index:i64}, {kind="create",instruction:i64}, or {kind="call",instruction:i64}. Parameter/create/call kind and exact original slot/instruction are semantically distinct. last_use is empty or the one actual final family-use instruction. Every alias and inherited View call result has the exact same owner/origin/last use as its family; every Array-origin call result has its own call origin even when owners equal. Verify all supplied rows exactly before normalization; no phantom entry/new family for a discarded View-origin result. Inherited alias/View-origin-call rows cannot have null last_use or a last_use before their defining alias/call instruction: both definitions consume an existing View operand at that instruction. A new checked-create/Array-origin-call row may be null only if its family has no actual View operand use; an unused formal may also be null. Every later family alias or use makes the entire family nonnull with that actual final instruction. At a call, fixed Published parameter structural effects are applied to mapped actual owner roots before the atomic View-actual use-completion. A View argument remains held through the call even if callee body/Derived is unread or Published.read=false. For every View family live through this call (last_use >= this call, including equality), a may-alias mapped structural owner is rejected. Distinct caller fresh owners may prove non-alias; formal Array/View owners conservatively may alias. No function specialization or global all-call rejection. Process effects and actual View operand use-completion first; only then register an Array-origin returned family. An existing family is active at a call only if its origin is a parameter or its create/call origin instruction is strictly before this call, with last_use>=call. The new family is not live during its own creating call. View-origin results extend the existing family through future uses/return. This ordering never exempts other pre-existing borrows of the mapped owner.
validation.scc: Compute direct-call closure over every complete function. Each cyclic node and its full outgoing reachable domain must contain neither Array create nor View checked-create. Acyclic incoming entry may allocate its actual before passing it to a recursive parameter-only function. Retain entry Fuel1; no blanket recursive refusal or allocation guard removal. The full cyclic outgoing union also forbids nominal View result/forwarding return even without any directly read payload; Array result remains unsupported everywhere.
validation.canonical: Both complete proof lists always represented; supplied absent/[] proof presence remains nonsemantic only after exact recomputation/equality. Publication presence is different: it retains actual explicit fixed context or the existing no-View acyclic absence route, never drops an upper. Owner/origin/nullable-last-use mapping is exact; no version-relabeled model or retained legacy decoder.
validation.integers: Before every counted read/write/allocation verify count<=role cap and count<=remainingBytes/recordMinimum when applicable; avoid overflow with limit-used subtraction and division before multiplication. Use full-u32 arithmetic in wide checked host integers for static ranges and metadata; future access checks are retained, not run.
validation.publication: Decode complete unchanged fixed v4 context; retain original complete functions/nominal actual result/full original Array/View slots/readonly flags and full wider upper. f64 returnOrigin=null, View returnOrigin=original Array/View parameter slot. Independently trace actual SSA/callee-first return origin and require exact fixed slot; reject local fresh escape even with repaired hashes. Recompute v4 contract/scope/whole digests using actual returnType, complete Derived and Effective<=fixed; borrow uses full upper before call completion. Unit presence only complete no-View DAG omitted-context route; no fake third argument/table, body narrowing, Source/HIR preimage or source-content reconstruction.
validation.returnOrigin: Represent exactly original Published4 JSON returnOrigin: null/Core UnitAttr for f64; {kind:"parameter",index:0..7}/Core DictionaryAttr for nominal View result. Referenced original full slot must be Array or readonly View. Independently trace the actual final View through full SSA aliases, checked View create, and complete direct calls; require the exact resulting full slot equals the fixed published slot. May-alias equality is not origin equality. Returning a local fresh Array owner or an unresolved/cyclic/scalar origin is rejected; do not accept a forged fixed slot or use it as evidence of actual origin. All existing Source/HIR owner16384 and borrow1024/event100/family-use50 budgets remain enforced by existing complete upstream validation; existing Core/cold owner16384, packet8MiB, liveness1000000 and operation ceilings remain. Return-origin reconstruction is one memoized callee-first pass over the already bounded complete View DAG: at most one registration per View formal, noncall View local, View call result and View return; no recursive expansion of bodies/call paths, no new input-proportional allocation beyond exact bounded tables. Fv+Pv+Lv+Qv<=16+128+272+512=928 registrations/module (loose joint bound, not an independent admissibility promise). Existing owner collection/effect meter and diagnostics retain their original charges; do not charge a repeated return-origin body traversal or alter old f64 fees.
